scope:
Experimental complete ContA with a compact serial FF access bank.

All 681 FF bits remain in the unchanged qualified helpers. RAM/window and phase
access retain their previous addresses; FF addresses are compact words0..37.
This requires a new schema/ABI and a global hold owner before core integration.

shared_file_manifest.exclusion_reason: Original synthesis translate_off diagnostics; no reference outside excluded region
shared_file_manifest.scope: Physical register-file/window state only; no global barrier, board integration, fit or machine restore
shared_file_manifest.area_experiment:
Fold exclusive F10145 normal/restore writes without changing either read port.

Preserves all74physical bits, asynchronous ordinary output, latched write window,
old-value administrative response and existing17-word state ABI. No new state,
pipeline, memory-placement change or global snapshot boundary is introduced.
shared_file_manifest.memory_implementation: original asynchronous MLAB style; registered admin reads exclude writes
shared_file_manifest.zero_write_experiment:
Experimental zero private write reply; public fabric already returns zero.

Every original state update, ordinary asynchronous output and snapshot read
stays unchanged. Only the unreleased private administrative write-result value
changes. Strict MLAB is an isolated placement experiment, never selected here
by the full-core builder before physical inference/timing qualification.
